## refund.created -> Xero credit note, paid out of the bank account
The Xero invoice is already paid, so the refund cannot be allocated to it: it becomes an AUTHORISED
ACCRECCREDIT credit note plus a cash refund payment (ARCREDITPAYMENT) from the same bank account.
Each partial refund is its own credit note. A refund waits until its invoice is in Xero.
Stripe: one `invoice_payments` lookup per refund. Xero: at most 4 calls per batch.
